parent.description: the feature it was folded into

from.description: the parent's head before the fold

to.description: the parent's head now: the folded feature's head

reparented.description: the folded feature's children, now stacked on parent with their fork points unchanged

deleted.description: each shadow-repo ref of the folded feature deleted, with the SHA it pointed at; empty under --plan

gate_pr.description: the folded feature's gate draft PR, closed; null when none was open
